title: Strategic Marketing Manager- Healthcare (Remote)
description:
Strategic Marketing Manager- Healthcare (Remote)

The Strategic Marketing Manager, will play a pivotal role on the marketing team as owner of the Behavioral Health market presence of SimiTree. This person will drive an upgraded and expanded presence in the Behavioral Health industry both digitally and across key organizational partnerships.

About SimiTree
SimiTree provides client-centric services to home health, hospice, private duty, pediatrics, applied behavioral analysis, palliative care, and other post-acute organizations. Our organization is made up of clinical, operational, and revenue cycle experts who support our clients. SimiTree has developed a full suite of custom-designed services focusing on areas critical to quality improvement, operational efficiency, accurate reimbursement, and regulatory compliance.

To provide our clients with an opportunity to focus on core operations, SimiTree provides outsourcing services for Coding and OASIS reviews, Billing and Collections, and full Revenue Cycle services. SimiTree's client base ranges from small, community-based agencies to publicly traded national chains. We have both the technical expertise and the real-world experience to implement seamless solutions that assist agencies in a rapidly changing operational and regulatory environment.

Responsibilities:
Strategic Marketing Plans
  • Develop and execute a quarterly marketing plan, getting buy-in from all key stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the support team for graphics, content, and conference execution.
  • Utilize market research to identify opportunities for growth and develop strategies that give your solutions better positioning in the market for the targeted demographics.
Content
  • Create and implement keyword strategy and work with content creators to support a content strategy that drives thought leadership and improved website analytics.
  • Work with contractors and collaborate with team to drive content development based on the above strategy.
Collaboration
  • Daily collaboration with various stakeholders, such as sales teams, solution leaders, and creative professionals.
Accountability
  • Create and distribute regular reporting showing true ROI that draws a line from spend to revenue by campaigns and campaign assets.

Competencies/Behaviors:
  • Bachelor's degree in digital marketing, marketing, communications, or relevant field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive marketing experience.
  • Experience with marketing automation, Pardot / Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Ability to communicate and influence effectively with key stakeholders.
  • Ability to conduct market research in an organized effort to gather information about target markets and customers.
  • Experience with keyword research and creating a content strategy.
  • Experience with Monday.com for project management.
  • Expert organizational skills to stay on top of ongoing projects.
  • Advanced email marketing to current and prospective customers with ability to compose intriguing and compelling subject lines and call-to-actions that drive increased engagement.
  • The ability to perform in a growth-mode company is required in a fast-paced environment.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills – the ability to ask and answer the right questions in the right way at the right time.
  • Ability to be adaptable, often changing actions, course, or approach in order to suit a new situation.

Education Requirements:
High School Diploma or equivalent.

Salary range/ Benefits:
$95,000- $110,000 annually

The compensation scale listed is a general salary range and is not intended to represent the actual annual or hourly compensation rate for this role. An offer will be made to the selected candidate at the conclusion of the interview process based on their relevant experience and the responsibilities of the position. description:
Account Success Representative (ASR) - Fully Remote

SimiTree is looking for an outstanding Account Success Representative to join our Revenue Cycle Management team to assist with providing quality outsourcing engagements for our customers in the post-acute industry. The primary focus of the Account Success Representative will primarily be account management of revenue cycle outsourcing engagements, specifically services related to eligibility and authorization for post-acute (home health, hospice, and private duty) providers. The goal of this role is to ensure client success through quality revenue cycle management services and to work alongside revenue cycle team to perform daily duties. A key component of this success is to provide superior customer service and validate key performance indicators to be at optimal levels. The position may require some travel as needed, but the work will mainly be remote.

About SimiTree
SimiTree provides client-centric services to home health, hospice, private duty, pediatrics, applied behavioral analysis, palliative care, and other post-acute organizations. Our organization is made up of clinical, operational, and revenue cycle experts who support our clients. SimiTree has developed a full suite of custom-designed services focusing on areas critical to quality improvement, operational efficiency, accurate reimbursement, and regulatory compliance.

To provide our clients with an opportunity to focus on core operations, SimiTree provides outsourcing services for Coding and OASIS reviews, Billing and Collections, and full Revenue Cycle services. SimiTree's client base ranges from small, community-based agencies to publicly traded national chains. We have both the technical expertise and the real-world experience to implement seamless solutions that assist agencies in a rapidly changing operational and regulatory environment.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Management of SimiTree RCM's engagements for clients
  • Conduct and manage RCM client onboarding for all assigned accounts; ensure all assigned RCM clients are onboarded successfully
  • Work with the Revenue Cycle Functional team who performs and completes insurance verification and eligibility for client's patients, as well as obtain authorization. Provide assistance and guidance to leadership and team members.
  • Develop monthly client dashboards and monitor key performance indicators for all assigned clients; set-up and monitor monthly cash goals for clients
  • Communicate with assigned clients on a regular basis; lead client monthly dashboard calls as well as other client meetings required
  • Report RCM key business metrics to clients while also routinely evaluating these KPIs are at optimal levels for all assigned clients
  • Develop monthly client invoices and ensure prompt submission to clients
  • Track revenue projections on assigned accounts and notify leadership of changes to projections based on account status
  • Proficient with outlook, excel, word, and PowerPoint

Qualifications:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience, post-acute provider experience.
  • Experience with Home Health/Hospice/ or other post-acute EMR systems.
  • Excellent customer service.
  • Strong quantitative and analytic skills, ability to solve problems.
  • Self-starter and motivation to complete work tasks independently.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, with strong excel skills including VLOOKUP and Pivot tables.

$70,000- $80,000
